login.title: CONFORA — sign in
login.subtitle: Pilot and production
login.description: Sign in continues at the organization identity provider. CONFORA does not ask for a password.
login.keycloakHint: You will return here after the identity provider confirms the session.

errors.failed: Sign-in failed. Check your credentials or try again later.
errors.sessionInvalid: Session is invalid or profile could not be loaded. Please sign in again.
errors.expired: The session expired. Sign in again.
errors.denied: Sign-in was not accepted. The account, organization, or authenticator step did not pass.
errors.connectionFailed: Cannot reach the API. Check that the backend is running and environment URLs are correct.
errors.nestConnectionFailed: Cannot reach the Nest auth API. Check Keycloak and VITE_CONFORA_API_URL.
